REBW.description: Rebar Input for Wall Section (REBW). Fields are driven by the wall rebar items list; each item carries vertical/horizontal rebar pairs plus optional sub-wall/story targeting, end rebar, boundary-element rebar, and thickness overrides that toggle further required data.

ITEMS.description: Wall rebar entries applied under this wall ID. Each entry either applies to the whole wall or to a specific sub-wall / story range.

CREATE_SUB_WALL_ID.description: Whether this entry targets a specific sub-wall keyed by story range. When true, STORY must be provided (and SUB_WALL_ID may target a specific sub-wall).

SUB_WALL_ID.description: Sub-wall ID to target. Applies when CREATE_SUB_WALL_ID=true; when omitted the first story in the resolved range is used as the sub-wall key.

STORY.description: [CREATE_SUB_WALL_ID=true] Story range (by story name) that the sub-wall spans. Required when CREATE_SUB_WALL_ID=true.

FROM.description: Start story name; must reference an existing story.

TO.description: End story name; must reference an existing story.

VERTICAL_REBAR.description: Vertical rebar for the wall (size + spacing).

NAME.description: Rebar size name (e.g. D4..D57); must be a valid registered rebar kind.

DIST.description: Rebar spacing; must be positive (supports non-SI unit conversion).

HORIZONTAL_REBAR.description: Horizontal rebar for the wall (size + spacing).

NAME.description: Rebar size name (e.g. D4..D57); must be a valid registered rebar kind.

DIST.description: Rebar spacing; must be positive (supports non-SI unit conversion).

USE_END_REBAR.description: Whether end rebar is used. When true, END_REBAR must be provided.

END_REBAR.description: [USE_END_REBAR=true] End rebar data. Required when USE_END_REBAR=true.

NAME.description: End rebar size name; must be a valid registered rebar kind.

NUM.description: End rebar number; must be at least 2 and an even number.

DIST.description: End rebar spacing; must be positive (supports non-SI unit conversion).

BE_HORIZONTAL_REBAR.description: Boundary element horizontal rebar (size + spacing). Optional; when provided the size must be a valid rebar kind and spacing must be positive.

NAME.description: Rebar size name (e.g. D4..D57); must be a valid registered rebar kind.

DIST.description: Rebar spacing; must be positive (supports non-SI unit conversion).

BOUNDARY_ELEMENT_LENGTH.description: Boundary element length; must be non-negative.

CONCRETE_FACE_TO_CENTER_OF_REBAR.description: Concrete face to rebar center distances (dw, de).

DW.description: Concrete face to center of vertical rebar (dw); must be non-negative.

DE.description: Concrete face to center of boundary element rebar (de); must be non-negative.

USE_MODEL_THICKNESS.description: Whether to use the wall element's model thickness. When false, THICKNESS must be provided.

THICKNESS.description: [USE_MODEL_THICKNESS=false] Wall thickness override; required and must be positive when USE_MODEL_THICKNESS=false.
